After t

bat
ch of our Expedition members of 28 th ISEA was flagged off by Shri 
Rasik R
avindra, Director NCAOR to embark upon a journey on 31st October, 
2008 towards Antarctica via Mumbai, Dubai and Cape Town. On the 
midnight of 5th November, 2008, we all took the IL-76 flight to Maitri 
and landed at
 Novolazarevskaya  Runway near Maitri in the very early hours 
of 6th November, 2008. Virtually this was the beginning of 28th ISEA.
The team members 
took a couple of days to acclimatize to Maitri  
environment and climate. 
Our first job was to repair and commission a non-
functional excavator. It took some time, but the machine proved to be an  
asset during the 
next few weeks. Simultaneously, we started the planning of 
our IT project. T
his was a gain a very important project because ultimately it 
proved to be the greatest help in warding off the monotony of Antarctic  
W
in
tering. Mishmi Hut  was selected as the IT hub of th e Summer 
Camp network at Maitri. Digging of a trench was started with the help of 
Excavator. Through this trench passed IT, Telephone & Electrical lines 
from main station to 
Summer Camp.
An Ove
rview of the 28th Indian Antarctic Expedition         xxvii
International co-operation in Antarctica. This operation was completed by
15th November, 2008.
With the installation of Earth Station by 26th & 27th ISEA teams in the
previous year, we were privileged with the availability of current news and
development around the world. We celebrated one such important event of
Chandrayan landing on Moon on 14th November at Maitri.
Landing of Chandrayan on Moon being celebra
ted at Maitri on 14th November
2008
From 16th November to 30th November 2008 our logistic team went
through hands on training programme under supervision of Mr. Marc Oliver
Blattner, from Kassbohrer Company which supplies the Pisten Bully vehicles
to our station. Our members utilised the opportunity to its maximum and
this was evident to me during the later phases of the expedition by observing
their vehicle handling & maintenance.
W orkshop training for 
Pisten Bully vehicles maintenance
xxviii Pradip 
Malhotra
While this work was going on at the workshop, other members were
busy in replacing the whole of old defunct duct line from Pump House to
Maitri Station from 18th November onwards. In the meantime other activities
were going on in full swing. Our scientists from NPL were busy in installing
the Digital Ionosonde Antenna near the Dobson Hut on a 28 metre high
tower with help from other members of the expedition.
Installati
on of Ionosonde
One scientist, Dr. Asim Bej of Tavani Expedition from USA, sponsored
by NASA, expressed his desire to work in and around the lakes of
Schirmacher oasis and asked for our assistance. Maitri members were too
happy to extend the hospitality and members from GSI, AU & NBRI worked
together with him on scientific issues.

was installed by our Scientist from IIG Shri C. Panneerselvam for

From 14th to 19th December 2009, an important task of widening and 
levelling of the road at Dozer Point, was taken up and successfully 
completed by the Logistic team members of 28 th ISEA. This will save 
wear & tear of our Pisten Bully vehicles.
